# Mandai Wildlife Reserve

> > Singapore's premier wildlife and nature destination featuring five world-class attractions dedicated to conservation, education, and immersive wildlife experiences.

Mandai Wildlife Reserve (operated by Mandai Wildlife Group) encompasses Singapore Zoo, Night Safari, River Wonders, Bird Paradise, and the newly opened Rainforest Wild Asia. The reserve is a global leader in conservation breeding, wildlife care, and sustainable tourism, home to iconic residents including giant pandas Kai Kai, Jia Jia, and Singapore-born Le Le.

## Conservation & Animal Births

- [Mandai Wildlife Group celebrates another baby boom with almost a thousand newborns in 2024](https://www.mandai.com/en/about-mandai/media-centre/mandai-wildlife-group-celebrates-another-baby-boom-with-almost-a-thousand-newborns-in-2024.html): Record 998 babies born across 143 species including threatened wildlife
- [Double joy as Rainforest Wild Asia welcomes first public-park goers and celebrates its first animal birth](https://www.mandai.com/en/about-mandai/media-centre/double-joy-as-rainforest-wild-asia-welcomes-first-public-park-goers-and-celebrates-its-first-animal-birth.html): Rainforest Wild Asia opening with Minister Grace Fu and first birth
- [Singapore Zoo celebrates reptile baby boom](https://www.mandai.com/en/about-mandai/media-centre/Singapore-Zoo-celebrates-reptile-baby-boom.html): RepTopia celebrates Philippine crocodile and gecko hatchings
- [Close to 400 Babies born and hatched in 2020](https://www.mandai.com/en/about-mandai/media-centre/close-to-400-babies-born-and-hatched-in-singapores-wildlife-parks-in-2020.html): Nearly 400 births across 107 species in 2020 conservation breeding
